title: Crypto Funding Rate Arbitrage Scanner
description: Scans perpetual futures funding rates across OKX, Gate.io, MEXC, HTX, KuCoin and Bitget, and returns cross-exchange funding-rate spreads ranked by annualized return. Find delta-neutral carry trades in seconds.

exchanges.title: Exchanges
exchanges.description: Which exchanges to scan. Valid values: okx, gate, mexc, htx, kucoin, bitget, binance, bybit. Binance/Bybit may be geo-blocked on some IPs (Apify cloud works). Unknown names are ignored.

minAprPct.title: Minimum APR (%)
minAprPct.description: Only return pairs whose annualized funding spread is above this value.

topN.title: Max results
topN.description: Maximum number of arbitrage opportunities written to the dataset, sorted by annualized return.
